summary: Azj-Kahet is the bottom of Khaz Algar and the last kingdom of living nerubians — the one the Scourge never took. Most of it is the City of Threads, a capital rebuilt on its own ruins so many times that height is rank: the favoured live at the top and the rest live in what is decaying underneath them. Queen Ansurek rules it in partnership with Xal'atath, which is not a popular arrangement; the wilds beyond the city hold niffen traders, deepwalkers and haranir, and a conspiracy called the Severed Threads is working the whole time to cut the queen down.
history: This kingdom survived what Azjol-Nerub did not. Its people came through mythic wars that repeated across millennia by outliving everyone who started them, and then kept to their own depths for a very long time. Xal'atath arrived after the Old Gods were dead and the Black Empire finished, and offered Ansurek the end of that isolation: a way back to power, and a means of remaking chosen nerubians into something stronger. The queen took it. Her people now harvest the Black Blood of the Old Gods inside Nerub-ar Palace and throw swarm after swarm at the Arathi in the cavern above. Enough nerubians disagreed to start conspiring instead.
